scripts.start: yarn --cwd ../.. rust:deps:check && cargo run --locked --quiet -p plec-cli -- serve dist
scripts.copy:fonts:public: mkdir -p public/assets/files && cp ../../node_modules/@fontsource-variable/outfit/files/*.woff2 public/assets/files/ && cp ../../node_modules/@fontsource-variable/raleway/files/*.woff2 public/assets/files/
scripts.copy:licenses: mkdir -p dist/public/licenses && cp ../../node_modules/lucide/LICENSE dist/public/licenses/Lucide-LICENSE.txt && cp ../../node_modules/@fontsource-variable/outfit/LICENSE dist/public/licenses/Outfit-OFL-1.1.txt && cp ../../node_modules/@fontsource-variable/raleway/LICENSE dist/public/licenses/Raleway-OFL-1.1.txt
scripts.build: yarn check:no-react && yarn build:plec && yarn copy:fonts && yarn copy:licenses && yarn build:css
